name: elliot_abe
description: Fly walking-bout filters (Fly50 skeleton, rectangular chamber). Filter logic runs natively in RED; this file only supplies the species/rig mapping.
_comment_scale: raw .rpred coords are divided by scale to get mm. The .rpred store holds RAW calibration-frame values (jarvis_predict_export.h writes them unmodified to data3D.csv), and the fly thresholds below were tuned against coords/10, so scale = 10.0. Confidence is NOT scaled.
_comment_keypoints: Names must exist in the loaded skeleton. body_ref is the posture/speed reference (thorax/scutellum).
_comment_defaults: Filter defaults RED loads into the UI. Live edits in RED override these; 'Reset to profile defaults' restores them.
